public_rationale: Reuters reported on July 17, 2026 that Meta and Anthropic were in preliminary compute-leasing talks that might not produce a deal [e1]. It reported that Anthropic proposed the deal in June [e1]. Reuters also quoted Zuckerberg's May statement that firms approached Meta almost weekly about its AI models or spare computing power [e1]. The report does not establish whether those approaches offered commercially viable alternatives or whether insufficient diversified demand explained Meta's consideration of Anthropic [e1]. The claimed cause remains unresolved [e1].
limitations: The packet contains no Meta decision records or verified commercial documents establishing the reason for the negotiations.
Reported approaches do not establish comparable customer offers, their scale or their commercial viability.
Available capacity, service costs, expected margins and an exclusive sales strategy are not established.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Meta is in talks to rent its capacity to Anthropic rather than selling it to a diverse set of customers because those customers do not exist at a scale that would make it worthwhile.

statement.excerpt: It’s because those customers do not exist at a scale that would actually make it worthwhile!

from_speaker: at a scale that would actually make it worthwhile
our_interpretation: Those customers means diversified purchasers of Meta's spare AI compute, outside the Anthropic deal discussed immediately before the sentence.
The ordinary reading is that insufficient economically viable diversified demand materially explains Meta's negotiations with Anthropic.
Worthwhile means commercially attractive given capacity, service costs, prices and contract terms. No numerical profitability hurdle is supplied.
The target is the July negotiations described in the context, through the July 22 post.
Negotiating with Anthropic does not itself establish that Meta rejected other customers or adopted an exclusive sales strategy.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous decision records, customer offers and capacity economics show that insufficient viable diversified demand materially caused Meta to pursue Anthropic.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable viable diversified demand existed, and reliable decision evidence shows that the asserted shortage did not explain Meta's choice.
